The '''Anyyon''', also called Guardians of An'yettu, were the paramilitary protectors of the [[An'yettu Islands/Legends|An'yettu Islands]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The [[An'yettu clan]] was at war with the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]], the largest [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan. The clan once hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to defend the islands.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
